en.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

footnotes.text: 107:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；

zhTraditional.text: 你們要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；

en.text: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

zhSimplified.text: 愿耶和华的赎民说这话，

zhTraditional.text: 願耶和華的贖民說這話，

en.text: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

zhSimplified.text: 从各地，从东从西，

zhTraditional.text: 從各地，從東從西，

en.text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在旷野荒地漂流，

zhTraditional.text: 他們在曠野荒地漂流，

en.text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

zhSimplified.text: 又饥又渴，

zhTraditional.text: 又飢又渴，

en.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；

en.text: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

zhSimplified.text: 又领他们行走直路，

zhTraditional.text: 又領他們行走直路，

en.text: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

zhSimplified.text: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱

zhTraditional.text: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛

en.text: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

zhSimplified.text: 因他使心里渴慕的人得以知足，

zhTraditional.text: 因他使心裏渴慕的人得以知足，

en.text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, in affliction and iron,

zhSimplified.text: 那些坐在黑暗中、死荫里的人 捆锁，

zhTraditional.text: 那些坐在黑暗中、死蔭裏的人 捆鎖，

en.text: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

zhSimplified.text: 是因他们违背 神的话语，

zhTraditional.text: 是因他們違背上帝的話語，

en.text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，他用劳苦治服他们的心；

zhTraditional.text: 所以，他用勞苦治服他們的心；

en.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；

en.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

zhSimplified.text: 他从黑暗中和死荫里领他们出来，

zhTraditional.text: 他從黑暗中和死蔭裏領他們出來，

en.text: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

zhSimplified.text: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱

zhTraditional.text: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛

en.text: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他打破了铜门，

zhTraditional.text: 因為他打破了銅門，

en.text: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

zhSimplified.text: 愚妄人因自己的过犯

zhTraditional.text: 愚妄人因自己的過犯

en.text: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

zhSimplified.text: 他们心里厌恶各样的食物，

zhTraditional.text: 他們心裏厭惡各樣的食物，

en.text: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華；

en.text: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

zhSimplified.text: 他发命医治他们，

zhTraditional.text: 他發命醫治他們，

en.text: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

zhSimplified.text: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱

zhTraditional.text: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛

en.text: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們以感謝為祭獻給他，

en.text: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

zhSimplified.text: 在海上坐船，

zhTraditional.text: 在海上坐船，

en.text: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

zhSimplified.text: 他们看见耶和华的作为，

zhTraditional.text: 他們看見耶和華的作為，

en.text: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

zhSimplified.text: 因他一吩咐，狂风就起来，

zhTraditional.text: 因他一吩咐，狂風就起來，

en.text: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

zhSimplified.text: 他们上到天空，下到海底；

zhTraditional.text: 他們上到天空，下到海底；

en.text: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

zhSimplified.text: 他们摇摇晃晃，东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；

zhTraditional.text: 他們搖搖晃晃，東倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；

en.text: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华，

zhTraditional.text: 於是，他們在苦難中哀求耶和華，

en.text: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

zhSimplified.text: 他使狂风止息，

zhTraditional.text: 他使狂風止息，

en.text: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

zhSimplified.text: 风息浪静，他们便欢喜；

zhTraditional.text: 風息浪靜，他們便歡喜；

en.text: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

zhSimplified.text: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱

zhTraditional.text: 但願人因耶和華的慈愛

en.text: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们在民的会中尊崇他，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們在民的會中尊崇他，

en.text: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

zhSimplified.text: 他使江河变为旷野，

zhTraditional.text: 他使江河變為曠野，

en.text: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

zhSimplified.text: 使肥地变为硷地；

zhTraditional.text: 使肥地變為鹼地；

en.text: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

zhSimplified.text: 他使旷野变为水潭，

zhTraditional.text: 他使曠野變為水潭，

en.text: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

zhSimplified.text: 他使饥饿的人住在那里，

zhTraditional.text: 他使飢餓的人住在那裏，

en.text: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

zhSimplified.text: 又种田地，栽葡萄园，

zhTraditional.text: 又種田地，栽葡萄園，

en.text: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

zhSimplified.text: 他又赐福给他们，叫他们生养众多，

zhTraditional.text: 他又賜福給他們，叫他們生養眾多，

en.text: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

zhSimplified.text: 他们又因暴虐、患难、愁苦，

zhTraditional.text: 他們又因暴虐、患難、愁苦，

en.text: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

zhSimplified.text: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，

zhTraditional.text: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，

en.text: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

zhSimplified.text: 他却将穷乏人安置在高处，脱离苦难，

zhTraditional.text: 他卻將窮乏人安置在高處，脫離苦難，

en.text: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

zhSimplified.text: 正直人看见就欢喜；

zhTraditional.text: 正直人看見就歡喜；

en.text: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 凡有智慧的，必在这些事上留心，

zhTraditional.text: 凡有智慧的，必在這些事上留心，
